name: supmartech-meta-ads-interest-finder
description: Search and evaluate Meta ad-targeting interests with SupMarTech.

interface.longDescription: Search Meta ad-targeting interests for up to five terms, review direct matches and related suggestions, and see approximate audience ranges returned by Meta. Score candidate interests with an explainable heuristic, group supplied interests into A/B/C test sets, estimate budget and time from assumptions you provide, and draft instructions for an AI agent to prepare a Saved Audience for your review. Search language does not select a country. Audience ranges can change, are not additive, and do not predict purchase intent or ad performance. Relevance scores and budget calculations are planning aids, not Meta predictions. The MCP tools do not connect to Ads Manager and cannot create, save, edit, publish, pause, or delete ads, campaigns, ad sets, or audiences. Search terms and technical usage data are processed as described in the privacy policy.
capabilities: Estimate test budgets from user assumptions
defaultPrompt: Find Meta ad interests for a coffee shop in Thailand.
Score these Meta interests for my skincare product and explain each score.
Estimate a test budget using my CPM, CTR, and conversion rate assumptions.

positive.description: Search direct and related Meta interests for a coffee business.
positive.prompt: Find Meta ad interests for a coffee shop. Search Coffee in English and show up to three direct matches and related suggestions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return direct matches separately from related suggestions, include Meta IDs and audience estimates when supplied, and explain that these estimates are approximate and do not create an audience or ad.

positive.description: Score supplied candidates and explain the score components.
positive.prompt: For a specialty coffee shop, compare Coffee and Coffeehouses. Search first if needed, then score the candidates and explain product fit, query relevance, audience-size preference, and name distinctiveness.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a score for each supplied or searched candidate with component-level reasons. Identify the method as heuristic and state that name similarity is not a measurement of actual audience overlap.

positive.description: Arrange user-provided interests into three comparison sets.
positive.prompt: Group Coffee, Coffeehouses, Coffee bean, and Coffee Machine into A/B/C test sets for a coffee shop. Do not create anything in Ads Manager.
positive.expected_behavior: Return non-duplicated sets with their strategy and any calculated scores. State that the sets are planning aids and do not guarantee independent or non-overlapping audiences.

positive.description: Estimate a scenario from explicit budget assumptions.
positive.prompt: Estimate a test for 30 results with THB 500 daily budget, CPM THB 100, CTR 1%, and conversion rate 2%. Show estimated CPA, results per day, days, and total budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Using the supplied assumptions, return estimated CPA of THB 500, about one result per day, about 30 days, and about THB 15,000 total. Clearly label the calculation as a scenario, not a forecast or guarantee.

positive.description: Draft a Saved Audience preparation prompt while requiring human confirmation.
positive.prompt: Create an English prompt for an AI agent to prepare a Thailand Saved Audience named Supmartech | Coffee using the Coffee and Coffeehouses interests. The agent must verify each interest and wait for my confirmation before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a copyable prompt with the exact audience name, location, and interests. It must require verification and explicit confirmation before saving, and must prohibit campaign or ad changes. The MCP tool itself performs no Ads Manager action.

negative.description: A request to create and publish an advertising campaign is outside the tool’s capabilities.
negative.prompt: Create a campaign in my Meta Ads Manager and publish it now.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call a tool to create, edit, or publish anything. Explain that this MCP only researches and plans interests, and cannot access Ads Manager or publish campaigns.

negative.description: A request for another person’s private account or advertising data is unsupported.
negative.prompt: Show me the private interests, audience, or ad account data of another Meta user.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt to retrieve private or account-specific data. Explain that the tools only search Meta targeting-interest data and do not access personal profiles or Ads Manager accounts.

negative.description: The search tool accepts at most five search terms per call.
negative.prompt: Search these six terms in one request: coffee, tea, bakery, skincare, running, and travel.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call the search tool with more than five terms. Ask the user to choose up to five terms or split them into multiple searches.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Added the reviewer-accessible video walkthrough URL for the initial MCP directory review.

th-TH.subtitle: ค้นหาและวางแผน Interest
th-TH.description: ค้นหา Interest สำหรับโฆษณา Meta ได้สูงสุด 5 คำ พร้อมแยกผลตรงกับคำแนะนำใกล้เคียงและดูค่าประมาณกลุ่มเป้าหมายจาก Meta ให้คะแนนความเกี่ยวข้องพร้อมเหตุผล จัด Interest ที่ให้มาเป็นชุด A/B/C ประมาณงบและเวลาทดสอบจากสมมติฐานของคุณ และร่างคำสั่งให้ AI เตรียม Saved Audience เพื่อให้คุณตรวจสอบ ภาษาค้นหาไม่ใช่ตัวกรองประเทศ ค่าประมาณอาจเปลี่ยนแปลงและใช้บวกเป็น Reach รวมไม่ได้ คะแนนและงบเป็นเครื่องมือช่วยวางแผน ไม่ใช่การพยากรณ์ผลโฆษณา MCP นี้ไม่เชื่อมต่อ Ads Manager และไม่สร้าง บันทึก แก้ไข หรือเผยแพร่โฆษณาและกลุ่มเป้าหมาย

zh-CN.subtitle: 搜索并规划 Meta 兴趣
zh-CN.description: 搜索 Meta 广告定位兴趣，查看直接匹配项、相关建议和 Meta 返回的受众规模估算；使用可解释的启发式方法评估相关性，将已提供的兴趣整理为 A/B/C 测试组，并根据您提供的假设估算预算与测试时间。还可生成供 AI 准备 Saved Audience 的指令，供您审核。搜索语言不会筛选国家。受众规模可能变化、不能相加，也不代表购买意向或广告效果。MCP 不连接 Ads Manager，也不会创建、保存、编辑或发布广告及受众。

ja-JP.subtitle: Meta広告の興味を検索・計画
ja-JP.description: Meta広告のターゲティングに使える興味関心を検索し、直接一致と関連候補、Metaが返す推定オーディエンス規模を確認できます。理由付きのヒューリスティック評価、A/B/Cテスト用グループ分け、入力した前提に基づく予算と期間の試算、Saved Audience準備用のAI指示文を作成します。検索言語は国を指定しません。推定値は変動し、合算や広告成果の予測には使えません。MCPはAds Managerに接続せず、広告やオーディエンスを作成・編集・公開しません。

ko-KR.subtitle: Meta 관심사 검색 및 계획
ko-KR.description: Meta 광고 타겟팅 관심사를 검색하고 직접 일치 항목, 관련 추천, Meta가 반환한 예상 오디언스 규모를 확인합니다. 설명 가능한 휴리스틱으로 관련성을 평가하고, 제공된 관심사를 A/B/C 테스트 세트로 나누며, 사용자가 입력한 가정으로 예산과 테스트 기간을 추정합니다. Saved Audience 준비를 위한 AI 프롬프트도 작성합니다. 검색 언어는 국가 필터가 아닙니다. 예상 규모는 변동될 수 있고 합산하거나 광고 성과를 예측하는 데 사용할 수 없습니다. MCP는 Ads Manager에 연결하거나 광고 및 오디언스를 생성·수정·게시하지 않습니다.

hi-IN.subtitle: Meta रुचियां खोजें
hi-IN.description: Meta विज्ञापन लक्ष्यीकरण की रुचियां खोजें, सीधे मिलान और संबंधित सुझाव अलग देखें, तथा Meta द्वारा लौटाए गए अनुमानित ऑडियंस आकार की समीक्षा करें। समझाए जा सकने वाले अनुमान से प्रासंगिकता अंकित करें, दी गई रुचियों को A/B/C परीक्षण समूहों में रखें, और आपके अनुमानों के आधार पर बजट व अवधि का हिसाब लगाएं। Saved Audience तैयार करने के लिए AI निर्देश भी बनाएं। खोज की भाषा देश फ़िल्टर नहीं है। ऑडियंस अनुमान बदल सकते हैं, जोड़कर कुल पहुंच नहीं बताई जा सकती, और वे विज्ञापन परिणाम की भविष्यवाणी नहीं हैं। MCP Ads Manager से नहीं जुड़ता और विज्ञापन या ऑडियंस नहीं बनाता, संपादित या प्रकाशित नहीं करता।

id-ID.subtitle: Cari dan rencanakan minat Meta
id-ID.description: Cari minat penargetan iklan Meta, lihat kecocokan langsung dan saran terkait secara terpisah, serta tinjau perkiraan ukuran audiens dari Meta. Nilai relevansi dengan metode heuristik yang disertai alasan, kelompokkan minat yang diberikan ke set uji A/B/C, dan hitung perkiraan anggaran serta durasi berdasarkan asumsi Anda. Buat juga prompt AI untuk menyiapkan Saved Audience agar dapat Anda tinjau. Bahasa pencarian bukan filter negara. Perkiraan dapat berubah, tidak boleh dijumlahkan, dan bukan prediksi performa iklan. MCP tidak terhubung ke Ads Manager dan tidak membuat, mengedit, atau menerbitkan iklan maupun audiens.
